leagues: 17 main European leagues (England 3 tiers, Spain 2, Italy 2, Germany 2, France 2, Netherlands, Portugal, Greece, Turkey, Belgium, Scotland)

rules.name: 1 Best price beats market average by 4%
rules.desc: best price x market-average chance >= 1.04, odds <= 5 (1X2 and O/U 2.5)

rules.name: 2a Short favourites (<=1.60)
rules.desc: favourite to win when the market average price is 1.60 or less

rules.name: 2b Long shots (>=5.00)
rules.desc: any result priced 5.00 or more at the market average

rules.name: 3 Against popular big clubs
rules.desc: opponent of a team that has been favourite at 60%+ on average this season, when that team plays away

rules.name: 4 Promoted teams early (rounds 1-8)
rules.desc: back a newly promoted team in its first 8 league matches

rules.name: 4b Against promoted teams early (NEW, judged on 2025 + this season)
rules.desc: back the opponent of a newly promoted team in that team's first 8 league matches (idea taken from rule 4's failure, so only 2025 and this season count)

rules.name: 5 End of season: motivated v nothing to play for
rules.desc: last 6 rounds: team within 3 pts of relegation or of top 3 v a mid-table team 6+ pts from both

rules.name: 6 Draws in tight, low-scoring matches
rules.desc: draw when the two teams are within 10 points of each other and Over 2.5 chance is under 45%

rules.name: 7 Rest advantage (3+ days more)
rules.desc: back the team with at least 3 more days of rest (league matches only)

rules.name: 8 Bet365 out of line with the market
rules.desc: Bet365 price x market-average chance >= 1.02 (bet at Bet365)

rules.name: 9 Lower divisions: best price beats average by 4%
rules.desc: rule 1 in second/third tiers only

rules.name: 9b Top divisions: best price beats average by 4%
rules.desc: rule 1 in top tiers only

rules.name: 10 Leagues where favourites paid in 2022-23
rules.desc: favourite to win, only in leagues where that was profitable at best price in 2022-23: B1, D2, E0, E2, F1, I1, P1, SC0, SP1, SP2, T1

rules.name: 11 Back Under against a market-wide Over drop
rules.desc: Over 2.5 price shortened 8%+ at Bet365 from early to closing and Pinnacle also shortened 5%+: back Under at the closing price

rules.name: 12 Bet365-only Over drop: back Under (possible public-money trap)
rules.desc: Over 2.5 shortened 8%+ at Bet365 but Pinnacle moved under 3%: back Under at the closing price

rules.name: 13 Compact team: Under when Over is short
rules.desc: Over 2.5 at 1.80 or less, one team low-scoring (last 8 matches ≤2.2 goals) and one side concedes ≤0.8 a game: back Under (pre-match price)

rules.name: 14a Draw, every match
rules.desc: Back the draw in every match (best pre-match price). Idea: bettors avoid draws, so draws may be priced too long (Lezana 2026).

rules.name: 14b Draw, evenly matched (|H-A| <= 0.10)
rules.desc: Back the draw when the market sees the teams as evenly matched (home and away chances within 10 points).

rules.name: 14c Away win, every match (odds <= 5)
rules.desc: Back the away team in every match, odds up to 5 (paper: away teams under-backed).

rules.name: 14d Away win, away chance >= 40%
rules.desc: Back the away team when the market gives it at least a 40% chance.
